target.metric: share of cases within 10 points of the reference split

note: PRD 1.0's remediation matrix is not in the repository; cases are built from the dispute rules of the shipped blueprints and the playground scenarios S2 and S4.

cases.source: Consulting M07 · Partial UAT: pro-rata by scripts passed

input.disputeRule: Partial UAT: pro-rata by scripts passed.
clauses: Work outside the signed design is a change request with its own price and milestone.
evidence: UAT sign-off sheet: 12 scripts in scope; key users signed 9 of 12 scripts as passed. Scripts 10–12 (intercompany billing) failed.
rebuttals: Provider: scripts 10–12 failed because the client's test data was not loaded on time.
Client: test data was loaded on day 18 as agreed in the kickoff minutes.

cases.source: Consulting M09 · Unclosed tickets: per-ticket deduction

input.disputeRule: Unclosed tickets: per-ticket deduction (each unclosed ticket deducts an equal share of 10 planned tickets).
evidence: Hypercare log: 10 tickets raised; 8 of 10 closed, 2 open (both severity 3) at handover.
rebuttals: Client: the two open tickets block month-end reporting.
Provider: both are cosmetic report-layout issues; workaround documented.

cases.source: Web M04 · Per-feature pro-rata if some features are missing

input.disputeRule: Per-feature pro-rata if some features are missing.
clauses: New features after M01 are priced as change requests and added to a later tranche.
evidence: Walkthrough video shows 6 of 8 backlog features working on staging.
rebuttals: Client: payments and notifications are the two missing features and they matter most.
Provider: notifications was redefined by the client on day 12 (change request CR-3 not yet signed).

cases.source: Interior M03 (Playground S4) · Millwork partly installed

input.disputeRule: Pro-rata by installed units against the signed drawing set.
clauses: Materials ordered under M02 remain the client's property.
evidence: Site photos with GPS within 30 m: 3 of 4 units installed per drawing M-04 (wardrobe, shelving, desk). The kitchen island unit is not installed.
Supplier note: island worktop delayed by the supplier, 2 weeks.
rebuttals: Client: I want 50% back because the room is unusable without the island.
Provider: three quarters of the work is done and photographed.

cases.source: Web M05 · Each failed check listed; fix within 72 hours (not fixed)

input.disputeRule: Each failed check listed; fix within 72 hours. Pro-rata by checks passed if not fixed.
evidence: Quality pass reports: 1 of 3 checks passed (dependency scan clean). Lighthouse mobile 71 (target ≥ 85); accessibility scan 4 serious issues.
Fix request sent on day 21; resubmission on day 25 shows the same scores.
rebuttals: Provider: the performance target is unrealistic with the client's chosen analytics scripts.

cases.source: Consulting M01 · Client delay extends dates day-for-day

input.disputeRule: Client delay in access extends all dates day for day; a milestone delayed only by client access is not a provider failure.
evidence: Access ticket log: system access requested day 1, granted day 9 by client IT.
Assessment report delivered day 12 (target day 5 + 7 days of client delay = day 12), 24 pages, all 8 processes covered.

cases.source: Web M06 · Rollback event goes to a mediator

input.disputeRule: Rollback event goes to a mediator.
clauses: The provider fixes defects against the agreed acceptance criteria for 30 days after launch.
evidence: Launch log: production deploy on day 24 rolled back after 40 minutes because database migrations failed; site restored from backup.
No second launch attempt within the window. Launch checklist not signed.
rebuttals: Provider: the migration failed because the client changed the production database version without notice.
Client: no notice was required; the version is listed in the hosting clause as client-managed.

cases.source: Classic car · Spoofed photos then valid proof (Playground S2)

input.disputeRule: Evidence must be taken at the workshop (GPS within 500 m); missing items listed and fixed within 72 hours.
evidence: First submission: 3 photos with GPS 85 km from the workshop (blocked).
Second submission within 48 h: 3 photos and a 2-minute drive video at the workshop, plate visible, motor and battery installed.
rebuttals: Client: the first photos were fake, so I do not trust the provider.

input.disputeRule: Force majeure: unrecoverable costs are shared 50/50; recoverable amounts are refunded.
clauses: Bookings cancelled by the provider are refunded in full.
evidence: Airport closed for 3 days by the civil aviation authority (notice attached). Two nights of non-refundable hotel bookings were lost; supplier refused credit.
rebuttals: Provider: the hotel nights are non-refundable and I paid them.

cases.source: Roofing · Inspection failed, no fix within window

input.disputeRule: Release only after the city inspection certificate; failed inspection must be fixed within 72 hours or the amount returns to the client.
evidence: City inspection report: FAILED (flashing missing on 2 valleys). Re-inspection not requested within 72 hours.
